errors.description: frame_header_q is a multi-bit value produced in csi_clk and sampled directly in isp_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
sof_pulse_q is a one-cycle csi_clk pulse consumed directly in isp_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
sof_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample isp_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in isp_event_o.
lane_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector lane_mode_q before decoding in isp_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
csi_rst_n is used as data inside isp_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines csi_clk payload state with isp_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
